steps.name: precheck-host-and-tables
args: SELECT now() AS captured_at, version() AS postgres_version, current_setting('shared_buffers') AS shared_buffers, current_setting('maintenance_work_mem') AS maintenance_work_mem; SELECT count(*) AS corpus_10k_rows FROM task68_spire_10k_load_corpus; SELECT count(*) AS queries_10k_rows FROM task68_spire_10k_load_queries; SELECT count(*) AS corpus_100k_rows FROM task68_spire_100k_load_corpus; SELECT count(*) AS queries_100k_rows FROM task68_spire_100k_load_queries; SELECT extname, extversion FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'ecaz'; SELECT amname FROM pg_am WHERE amname = 'ec_spire';
